run_dqn_on_bsuite_env: run a DQN agent on a given bsuite environment and log results to CSV
run_dqn_sweep_multiprocess: run a DQN agent across a sweep of bsuite environments using MPI multiprocessing
configure_dqn_hyperparameters: configure DQN hyperparameters like learning rate, batch size, and replay buffer capacity via flags
load_and_record_bsuite_env: load a bsuite environment with recording enabled for CSV or SQLite logging
wrap_dmenv_for_gym: wrap a DeepMind environment with GymFromDMEnv to make it compatible with OpenAI Gym
